QuestInfo.name: Admission to the VIP Zone
QuestInfo.0: Could it be...? Is it really the VIP Zone in Kerning Square? Rush over to #bJune#k!
QuestInfo.1: He says he'll let you enter the VIP Zone if you bring him VIP Tickets. He says you can get them from any monster in Kerning Square.
QuestInfo.2: He says the VIP Zone can be entered once every 30 minutes. Go see #bJune#k when the 30 minutes are up.

0.0: Move out of the way! This isn't a place just anyone can enter! What? You really want to go in here?

yes.0: Fine. Then bring me #b10 VIP Tickets#k from the monsters in Kerning Square. I'll let you enjoy the VIP Zone for exactly 10 minutes. That doesn't mean that you can bring me 5 tickets and enter for 5 minutes... You must bring me 10 tickets, okay?

no.0: Then move out of the way.
